productive_outcomes: Express a single negative proposition with finite ne and a negative person, thing, or determiner; distinguish this negative concord from affirmative constituent contrast with nā.

Produce all twelve selected indicative positions of nabban and negative willan, and the complete twelve-position negative wesan/eom/wæs system; retain composite uncontracted expressions as their component words.
Produce the complete strong NGDA system of nān and the eight personal/neuter NGDA positions of gehwā/gehwæt in the bounded ordinary negative and distributive uses.
Distinguish an interrogative person from an indefinite person in a condition, an unnamed person introduced by ān, and the defective impersonal nominative man expression.

Build a free-choice clause using the case demanded inside that clause and an explicit resumptive pronoun when the main-clause relation differs; account for contextual subjunctive choice without treating an introductory word as an automatic mood switch.
Distinguish singular distribution from a plural total, coordinate both objects with ǣgðer ge … ge, and distinguish personal partitive uncer from the agreeing possessive.
Keep equative comparison, preferential swīðor, quantity, and proportional swā … swā distinct in meaning and structure.

Produce the independently assigned complete nominal and verbal systems with their evidenced stem alternations, ending rules, exceptions, and bounded ordinary senses; reference cells retain their separate scope.
Translate all fifty original Cook prompts with their original lexical, participant, number, mood, omission, and word-order controls, using visible help for expressly supplied dependencies.
recognition_outcomes: Identify the negative and indefinite family members explicitly retained as supplied citations, including anything/nothing, -hwega, and unused either/neither variants; do not infer unseen forms or independent productive use.
Explain case and number despite syncretic surfaces, especially root nouns, sweostor, nān, gehwā, personal uncer, and possessive uncer.
Follow the complete opening argument of Duties: withheld gifts, withdrawal of bounty, promised repayment, the embedded quotation, and the speaker's identification with the least recipients.
Follow Alfred's complete preface: two methods of translation, practical obstacles, later versification, the request to readers, and changes of pronoun referent in the final comparison.
Follow the complete prayer: grounds of entreaty, subjunctive request, successive imperatives, the two standards of comparison, purpose, the list of divine roles, and the concluding wish.
Recognize exact supported source forms and constructions while preserving their lexical, number, case, and discourse limits.
bounded_scope: The baseline is the actual fourteen active contracts and cumulative registers at 9129cda; archived-course teaching creates no prerequisite credit.
A complete morphology table does not teach every construction or sense. Productive, recognition, and supplied status is recorded independently for each form, sense, and feature.
Negative willan indicative forms do not promote the earlier supplied negative subjunctive nolde. The present negative wesan table includes both contracted and explicitly composite positions.
No nytan paradigm is introduced merely to complete a list of negative verbs: it is absent from the assigned exercises and readings.
Nān has its complete assigned strong NGDA system; instrumental and unassigned variants retain explicit reference limits. Gehwā has singular personal and neuter columns without invented plural forms.
Impersonal man is a bounded nominative singular expression. The ordinary count noun retains its earlier separate forms and sense.

The selected full noun systems distinguish productive count meanings from reference-only number positions for abstract or mass nouns. Engle and Dęne receive their documented plural systems without fabricated singular ethnonyms.

Rare ordinals, the exact fifty-two-years expression, proper-name spellings, source-specific case attraction, and exceptional reader constructions remain visibly supplied where the final inventory so records.
The Duties assignment is its complete first argument, not the full outer direct speech. The continuation on printed 160–161 is unassigned. The Preface and Prayer are complete.
All 27 original reader notes and 33 anchors remain separate from modern help. Their embedded questions become tasks only where the task plan explicitly assigns an output.
Eight short translated teaching examples have their own exact whole-sequence bindings and ungraded teaching records. No extra connected narrative or unbound worked example is included.
This proposal precedes the learning contract. Learner prose, final keys, blind learner-solving review, independent paradigm/source review, and exported-page review remain later stages.
teaching_order_rule: All grammar, required complete lexical systems and vocabulary precede the practice blocks. Present the full bōc table and ordinary sense before any example or task that uses it. Place each translated example after its needed morphology, meanings and construction have been explained. The stages below group practice within the prepared unit; they do not delay a prerequisite until a later practice stage. Keep assigned local helps visible from the start of each affected task.
